title: Rotation Period of a White Dwarf
body: The Sun's mass is $$2.0\times10**{30}\,\text{kg}$$, $$its$$ $$radius$$ $$is$$ $$7.0\times10**{5}\,\text{km}$$, $$and$$ $$it$$ $$has$$ $$a$$ $$rotational$$ $$period$$ $$of$$ $$approximately$$ $$28$$ $$days$$. $$It$$ $$collapses$$ $$into$$ $$a$$ $$white$$ $$dwarf$$ $$of$$ $$radius$$ $$3.5\times10**{3}\,\text{km}$$, $$no$$ $$mass$$ $$is$$ $$ejected$$, $$and$$ $$a$$ $$sphere$$ $$of$$ $$uniform$$ $$density$$ $$(I=(2/5)MR**{2})$$ can model the Sun both before and after.
